current_syllabus_status: Agricultural Science 2025 v1.3 (January 2026) is the current syllabus; the official subject page lists it under 'Agricultural Science General senior syllabus 2025' for implementation with students who will complete the course in 2026 or beyond. No superseded syllabus was registered; the past papers and 2019-era sample instruments listed on the page are historical assessment-support material and are not part of the current syllabus package.
